L A Y O F F S · M E T H O D R E V I E W · 2 S E P T E M B E R 2 0 2 6 What the SDID literature actually does

Twelve marketing papers and three replication codebases, read for empirical

mechanics only. The short version: your architecture is the field's architecture, your

inference is ahead of the published bar, and you are missing four cheap things that

every one of these papers has.

12 PAPERS 3 REPLICATION REPOS READ LINE BY LINE 5 USE SDID AS THE PRIMARY ESTIMATOR

I The consensus architecture

Five of the twelve use SDID as the headline estimator. Every one of those five does the

same three things: fit SDID separately per cohort or per treated unit, aggregate with

treated-count weights, and get the standard error from a jackknife. Your pipeline does all

three.
